question: The 24th edition of the World Sustainable Development Summit 2025, organised by TERI, commenced in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **24th** edition of the **World Sustainable Development Summit (WSDS)**, which is the flagship annual event of **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)**, is scheduled to be held in **New Delhi** in **February 2025**.
 
• The summit serves as a premier international platform that brings together Nobel laureates, political leaders, and decision-makers from across the globe to deliberate on **sustainable development** and **climate change** solutions.
 
• The **2025** edition focuses on accelerating action toward achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** and addressing the specific challenges faced by the **Global South** in the context of **climate resilience**.
